enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Snore. Move arm. Turn to left side. Shift position. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Breathe deeply.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, getting dressed for work
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up clothes. Put on shirt. Put on pants.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Toast bread in toaster. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Pour coffee into mug. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Eat toast. Drink coffee. Clear dishes. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the health care facility for the morning shift
enriched_activities.desc: Put on coat. Pick up bag. Open door. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to facility. Enter building. Turn off phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at facility. Change into scrubs. Check schedule. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Check temperature. Administer medication. Update patient chart. Consult with colleague. Attend meeting. Eat lunch. Wash hands. Return to work. Complete rounds. Update charts. Leave facility.
Leave facility. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door. Lock door. Turn on light.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, cleaning up the dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Add vegetables. Cook. Turn off stove. Serve food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and running a load of laundry in the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Undress. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on clean clothes. Open washing machine. Put dirty clothes in. Add detergent. Close door. Select cycle. Start washing machine.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV and using the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Flip channels. Stop on a channel. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Type on keyboard. Browse internet. Check email. Watch video. Adjust volume. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Pick up phone. Continue watching TV. Use computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, setting out clothes and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Open closet. Pick out shirt. Pick out pants. Lay clothes on chair. Close closet. Turn on lamp. Sit on bed. Take off shoes. Take off socks. Remove watch. Plug in phone. Set alarm. Turn off light. Lie down.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Snore. Move arm. Turn to left side. Shift position. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Breathe deeply.
